rationale: Price is sitting just 0.17% above today's low ($41.77) with the last five 1-minute candles showing a tight, low-momentum drift lower on declining volume — no clear reversal signal to support a long, and no meaningful bounce to fade for a short. The stock has already gapped down 3.3% and sold off further intraday, placing it at the extreme low of its range, but with ATR of only ~$0.11 on 5-minute bars and 91 minutes to close, the risk/reward on either side is compressed and the directional edge is insufficient to justify a position given today's already-negative P&L.
